# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# STAGE-DECK STARTER  — copy this file + brand.scss into a new stage's deck/
# folder, then fill in the three placeholders (title / subtitle / footer) and
# write your slides. Everything else (theme, fonts, chart styling) is shared.
# Render:  quarto render <thisfile>.qmd --to revealjs
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
title: "STAGE TITLE HERE"                    # e.g. "How Well Can We Rank Default Risk?"
subtitle: "Stage name · Home Credit data"    # e.g. "Probability-of-Default model · Home Credit"
author: "Chuch"
date: today
date-format: "MMMM YYYY"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, brand.scss]
    slide-number: c/t
    transition: fade
    transition-speed: fast
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    center: false
    menu: false
    progress: false
    auto-stretch: false
    fig-align: center
    echo: false
    embed-resources: true
    footer: "Stage name · Home Credit Default Data"   # shown on every content slide
title-slide-attributes:
    data-background-color: "#3D2E4F"
    data-background-gradient: "radial-gradient(120% 135% at 12% 4%, #5C4577 0%, #3D2E4F 52%, #2C2039 100%)"
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
  freeze: auto
jupyter: python3
---

#| label: setup

# Standard boilerplate: find the repo root, then pull in the shared brand system.
import os, sys, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def find_repo_root(start, name="CreditRiskLearning"):
    p = os.path.abspath(start)
    while True:
        if os.path.basename(p) == name:
            return p
        parent = os.path.dirname(p)
        if parent == p:
            raise FileNotFoundError(name)
        p = parent

REPO = find_repo_root(os.getcwd())
sys.path.append(os.path.join(REPO, "Core Resources"))
sys.path.append(os.path.join(REPO, "Core Resources", "Scripts"))

from python_style_util import p, f, s, C
from deck_utils import (deck_style, BRAND_RAMP, add_baseline,
                        strip_bar_labels, small_labels, reset_labels)
deck_style()

<script>
// Optional: cover stat chips + kicker (delete if you don't want them).
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const t = document.getElementById('title-slide');
  if (t && !t.querySelector('.cover-meta')) {
    const head = document.createElement('div');
    head.className = 'cover-head';
    head.innerHTML = '<div class="cover-kick">02 &nbsp;·&nbsp; Stage Name</div><div class="cover-rule"></div>';
    t.insertBefore(head, t.firstChild);
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'cover-meta';
    d.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cm"><span class="cm-n">0000</span><span class="cm-l">Metric one</span></div>
      <div class="cm"><span class="cm-n">0.00</span><span class="cm-l">Metric two</span></div>
      <div class="cm"><span class="cm-n">0.0%</span><span class="cm-l">Metric three</span></div>`;
    t.appendChild(d);
  }
});
</script>
